objective: Evaluate existing hosted architectures that combine reference-image guidance with a separate exact QR structural control, using the frozen Core scan authority and deterministic fallback.
scope: ribbon-M and wolf reference targets only
reference-fidelity review, provenance, latency, cost, and fallback
nonGoals: full eight-reference expansion without phase gate

criteria.requirement: Identify two live architectures that consume reference pixels and a separate exact QR structural control.
criteria.evidence: Replicate schemas: anotherjesse/multi-control exposes qr_image plus canny_image; chigozienri/ip_adapter-sdxl-controlnet-canny exposes image plus controlnet_input.

criteria.requirement: Generate eight outputs per architecture-target pair with exact model/version/seed/latency/cost/hash provenance.
criteria.evidence: IP-Adapter architecture generated 8 outputs per target; QR-specific multi-control hosted build failed four reproducible calls before output.

criteria.requirement: Promote only if a pair yields at least one clear-reference candidate with raw decode and at least 6/8 perturbation checks.
All failed provider outputs remain export-denied; deterministic fallbacks preserve exact payload and pass Core threshold.
criteria.evidence: 16/16 provider outputs denied; four fallbacks passed 7/8, 8/8, 8/8, 8/8 with exact payload equality.

criteria.requirement: Core gates, evidence validator, hashes, clean owned-scope diff, commit, and bundle verification pass.
criteria.evidence: Core 24/24, Artistic 136/136 TypeScript plus 6/6 Python, Q6 evidence validator, contract diff, manifest, commit, and final bundle verification passed.

allowed: use existing Replicate token and prepaid credit
run at most 8 provider predictions producing at most 32 images

resourceLimits.limitVariance: One IP-Adapter prediction remained queued without starting and was canceled at the timeout; its authorized recovery retry produced the first successful batch. The queue-only attempt reported zero predict-time cost.

recoveryAction: Persist each completed prediction and output immediately; resume by prediction ID without repeating paid calls.
nextTransition: Product Architect independently verifies the negative result. Further generative work requires an approved maintained custom-model/GPU lane.
